observations: Orange gas cylinder with 'RESTON' printed in white on the side.
Significant rust and peeling paint on the top dome and the protective shroud.
The valve appears to be missing, leaving only the threaded opening visible.
Photo 1 is a duplicate of Photo 0.

claims.evidence: The weight stamp is not visible in the provided photos.
The valve is missing in the photos, and the heavy rust on the pressure-bearing dome suggests a safety risk that would fail standard testing.

risks.risk: Structural integrity failure due to deep corrosion on the dome.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the rusted area after cleaning to show the depth of metal pitting.
A photo of the cylinder with a valve installed and a video of a leak test.
A clear photo of the manufacture and expiry date stamps usually found on the handle or shroud.

proof_requests: Photo of the weight and expiry date stamps on the handle or shroud.
Photo showing the valve attached to the cylinder.
Close-up photo of the rust to see if it is surface-level or deep pitting.
response.reason: The item is identifiable as a RESTON gas cylinder shell. Due to the visible heavy rust and missing valve, it is priced at its worst case as a damaged, uncertified shell requiring refurbishment.
